answer.text: Right, but not obligation, to enter an IRS
Outright ownership of a floating-rate bond

explanation.text: The Logic: The holder of a payer swaption has the right, but not the obligation, to enter into an interest rate swap. The seller has the obligation and charges an option premium that is paid upfront. The Trap: An obligation to enter would describe a forward swap, not a swaption. A swaption does not deliver outright ownership of a bond and is not a currency hedge. Note: The option premium compensates the seller for taking on the obligation if the buyer exercises.
